column1: # Ukrainian stress the lexicon gets wrong for homographs: it picks the infinitive reading for finite -ить / -иться forms (робить, просить), the locative / genitive reading for добрі / добра, and the singular for господар* plurals. word<TAB>stress (vowel index from the end); read before STRESS_TABLE and the lexicon.

# Source: the stressed forms in the en.wiktionary Ukrainian extract; господарі́ (plural) as in the standard dictionaries. Case homographs with two common readings (тепла, сорока, бджоли ...) are NOT listed: that needs context.
